goal: Add src/application/create-customer-commit-service.mjs, a small framework-neutral Application-ring service composing one exact CreateCustomerPipeline instance with one injected commit port, so an ALLOW_COMMIT outcome can be committed exactly once through an injected port and a non-allow outcome is preserved with commitReceipt: null and no commit call.

scopeResolution.note: CreateCustomerCommitService's constructor accepts exactly { pipeline, commit }: pipeline must be an exact CreateCustomerPipeline instance (prototype identity, not instanceof), commit must be a function. handle(actionSpec) runs pipeline.run(actionSpec). A non-ALLOW_COMMIT outcome is returned frozen with outcome/requestId/error preserved and commitReceipt: null, and commit is never invoked. An ALLOW_COMMIT outcome calls commit(preparedChangeSet, { tenantId: preparedChangeSet.intents.customer.tenantId }) exactly once, awaits the frozen CommitReceipt the injected port returns, and answers a frozen result with outcome: "COMMITTED", requestId, error: null, preparedChangeSet: null, commitReceipt. The service never imports the Postgres adapter and touches no clock, random value, environment, socket or file.

red.note: Before this package: the test file imported ../src/application/create-customer-commit-service.mjs, which did not exist, so node --test failed at module resolution with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any assertion ran.

green.results: kernel-create-customer-commit-service.test.mjs: 5/5 pass, proving the constructor rejects a non-exact pipeline, a non-function commit, a missing key and an extra key; a DENY outcome and an INVALID outcome are both returned frozen with commitReceipt: null and never call commit; an ALLOW_COMMIT outcome calls commit exactly once with the preparedChangeSet and { tenantId }, and the result is a frozen COMMITTED with preparedChangeSet: null and the injected CommitReceipt. npm run check: exits zero.

acceptance.constructorShape: constructor accepts exactly { pipeline, commit }; pipeline must be an exact CreateCustomerPipeline instance; commit must be a function; anything else throws TypeError
acceptance.nonAllowPreserved: a non-ALLOW_COMMIT outcome is returned frozen with its outcome/requestId/error unchanged and commitReceipt: null; commit is never called
acceptance.allowCommitsOnce: an ALLOW_COMMIT outcome calls commit(preparedChangeSet, { tenantId }) exactly once and awaits its frozen CommitReceipt
acceptance.committedResultShape: the returned frozen result carries outcome: "COMMITTED", requestId, error: null, preparedChangeSet: null, commitReceipt
acceptance.frameworkFree: no HTTP/ASGI/delivery import, no Postgres adapter import, no clock/random/env/socket/file access anywhere in the service module

rollback.trigger: the service is found to call commit more than once, to call commit on a non-allow outcome, to leak preparedChangeSet on COMMITTED, or to import a delivery/Postgres/framework dependency
rollback.action: revert src/application/create-customer-commit-service.mjs, tests/kernel-create-customer-commit-service.test.mjs, this planning file and the CHANGELOG.md entry as one shard
rollback.blastRadius: this new Application-ring service and its test only; CreateCustomerPipeline, the Postgres adapter and every delivery surface are untouched
rollback.runtimeDataImpact: none; the service opens no database connection and the test suite injects a fake commit port

once: CreateCustomerPipeline yalnız kararı verirdi (ALLOW_COMMIT/DENY/INVALID/CROSS_TENANT_DENY); kararı gerçek bir kayda çevirecek bir bağlama noktası yoktu.
simdi: CreateCustomerCommitService, pipeline kararını alıp ALLOW_COMMIT ise dışarıdan verilen commit fonksiyonunu tam bir kez çağırıyor ve dönen makbuzu (CommitReceipt) sonuca ekliyor; ALLOW_COMMIT değilse commit hiç çağrılmıyor, karar aynen korunuyor.
fark: Yeni dosya src/application/create-customer-commit-service.mjs eklendi; hiçbir mevcut dosya davranışı değişmedi.
kullaniciYolculugu: Bir CRM temsilcisi 'yeni müşteri ekle' formunu gönderdiğinde: pipeline izin/red kararını verir; izin varsa bu servis kaydı gerçek commit portuna iletip makbuzu döner; red/geçersiz ise commit hiç denenmez. Ama bu servisi çağıran bir HTTP/form katmanı henüz yok — bu paket sadece o bağlama noktasını hazırlıyor.
kalanEngel: Servisi gerçek bir delivery/HTTP katmanına ve gerçek PostgresCommitAdapter'a bağlayan uç henüz yazılmadı; ürün hâlâ çalıştırılamıyor.
